c.v: port signals to specified pins via GPIO Matrix.
For core0, their names are pro_alonegpio_in0~7.
For core1, their names are core1_gpio_in0~7.
Then you can read the eight GPIO pin levels and store them to the AR register through instruction EE.GET_GPIO_IN.
Using this method, you can get and handle the level changes on GPIO pins faster than reading registers to get pin level status.
